check.title: Sound check
check.body: Check that this phone can play and hear the handshake sound.
check.bodyTip: The sound has two layers: a jingle you can hear and a high tone most people can't. Nothing is recorded: the sound is decoded on this device and then forgotten.
check.played: Played the tune with code {code}. Listen on the other device and compare the codes.
check.playQuiet: Play only the high tone (quiet mode)
check.listening: Listening for up to 15 seconds. Play the sound on the other device now.
check.missedUltra: Didn't hear the high tone. Some phones can't play or hear it; the jingle still works.
check.volumeLow: The sound was faint. Turn the volume up on the playing device and hold the phones closer.
check.nothing: Didn't hear the sound. Turn the volume up on the playing device and try again.
check.noMic: This device can't use its microphone. Allow microphone access for this site and try again.
check.noAudio: This device can't play sound right now.
